setting: You are both in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, and you are father and daughter, so you know each other from family life. Linh works at a hotel reception in the city, and Long fixes motorbikes. You have lived near each other for years and speak often about family matters.

private_lines.Linh: You work the front desk at a hotel in the city, checking guests in and out on shifts that rotate through the week. You live in a small apartment in the city and spend your free time cooking simple meals and catching up with friends after work. Your days are busy with guests and hotel routines, and you usually get home tired in the evening.
private_lines.Long: You run a small motorbike repair shop in Ho Chi Minh City, fixing scooters and bikes for neighbors and passersby. You live in a house in the same city with your family, and your days start early with customers and end when the shop closes in the evening. You spend quiet evenings at home with a simple meal and the news on the radio.
